question: Does replacing the autonomous tangent Phi*(e@W) mean transport by the exact target-free Gaussian ReLU secant explain a material part of the autonomous-state gap?

hypothesis.control: The frozen exposure-trained H64 model and its original tangent transport.
hypothesis.intervention: At each corrected layer compute dmu=e_prev@W and transport F(mu+dmu,sigma)-F(mu,sigma), where F(mu,sigma)=sigma*(phi(mu/sigma)+(mu/sigma)*Phi(mu/sigma)); keep the frozen local network, gains, host, features, and weights unchanged.
hypothesis.causal_read: A material improvement implicates missing Gaussian mean-map curvature. No improvement closes this curvature mechanism and points instead to a missing variance/covariance or other typed state.

stop_gates.primary_meaning: at least 5% below the frozen parent autonomous result
stop_gates.promotion_rule: Promote the exact secant mechanism to full-688 only if the primary 5% gate passes; otherwise stop this mechanism after the single development evaluation.
